evidence.summary: 在 DSH 与 MCP 中查询 Garmin 健身健康数据，并支持本地 FIT 导出及预览确认后的训练管理。
limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

limitations: 包/Host入口、workspace Host/server/service与MCP转发、工具账号选择/registry代理、Connect查询/写deadline、Personal adapter、browser auth持久接线/flow/server、session store、tool service训练/FIT、cache与fit exporter关键路径；未执行，未完整审外部SDK、UI/租约/教练持久层和所有健康指标。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 已有Garmin记录、接受数据进入所选模型的用户，可小范围读历史并与官方应用核对，见 [Q01](#research-q01)。
DSH/MCP接同workspace账号服务，按稳定ID选provider，Connect SDK或Personal API读取；训练写有一次预览句柄与参数/身份校验，见 [Q02](#research-q02)至 [Q05](#research-q05)。

包/Host入口、workspace Host/server/service与MCP转发、工具账号选择/registry代理、Connect查询/写deadline、Personal adapter、browser auth持久接线/flow/server、session store、tool service训练/FIT、cache与fit exporter关键路径；未执行，未完整审外部SDK、UI/租约/教练持久层和所有健康指标。

#### 依赖

| 条件 | 用途 | 缺失或边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Node ^20.19或>=22.13 | Host/MCP进程 | 与部署实际版本核 |
| Cordis/DSH connection/ui peers或MCP | 接入面 | 未验Host兼容 |
| Garmin账号/区域/Personal key或浏览器MFA | 查询凭据 | provider能力不同 |
| 精确维护SDK1.7.0及Personal适配 | 数据接口 | 外部SDK完整实现未审 |
| 私有目录/本地workspace凭据 | 会话/共享服务 | 同用户进程信任另核 |
| 所选模型/隐私同意 | 数据解释 | 插件本身不保证分析效果 |

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金/资源 | 人工时间 | 边界 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 首次 | 已有账号设备/Node/浏览器 | peers/区域/登录配置 | 不为试用购订阅 |
| 持续 | Garmin API与模型usage | 过期重登/数据核对 | 真实费用未知 |
| 失败 | 读请求/可能远端写 | 认证或结果未知排查 | 写不可自动重复 |
| 退出 | 会话/FIT/教练材料 | 停共享服务/撤key | 已给模型数据不可收回 |
试用仅限已有账号的少量历史查询，专用profile隔离写/导出，稳定ID与官方应用核对。无法确认数据去向/写权限就停止，回官方应用/手工导出，见 [Q06](#research-q06)。

#### 效果

| 效果 | 支持 | 未确认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 数据接入 | 实际provider/账号调用链 | 指标覆盖/实时性 |
| 训练管理 | 预览/部分成功/未知状态 | 可信人批/设备同步 |
| FIT导出 | 有界归档与独占本地写 | SDK下载流/Windows权限 |
| 健身建议 | 工具/本地知识材料 | 健康/训练净效果 |
有身份代际、一次性预览、结果未知和本地文件防御的实际实现；需区分同用户信任、外部SDK、客户端取消/远端完成与共享owner退出，见 [Q02](#research-q02)至 [Q05](#research-q05)。
把多账号健身数据经本地认证、能力分流与共享workspace提供给DSH/MCP；训练写把参数预览和部分成功/未知显式返回，但不证明人类批准或设备接收，见 [Q02](#research-q02)至 [Q04](#research-q04)。
训练确认是调用方布尔+句柄，不是独立批准；超时不回滚，通用Retry可掩盖写未知；健康数据会进入所选模型，SDK/真实认证兼容未验，见 [Q03](#research-q03)、[Q04](#research-q04)。
未验证方向是可信批准加阶段收据，先用三个故障/身份样本测误重试和误认完成，已有机制足够则放弃，见 [Q07](#research-q07)。

technical.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)SDK适配/共享账号为常规集成，novelty25%超纯文档0，未新方法不达50%。[Q04](#research-q04)tool-service768-919和client1050-1075把确认绑定/部分成功/未知写接实，mechanism50%超25%描述包装；无持久幂等/独立人批不达75%。[Q02](#research-q02)workspace-service40-69与mcp229-244复用跨DSH/MCP服务，transferability50%超局部，宿主/外部SDK未验不达75%。[Q03](#research-q03)共享认证与私有写把重复配置集中，simplification25%超0但多套身份/浏览器/owner复杂度不达50%。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)/[Q04](#research-q04)用户仍审自己的训练，工具入口未改变分工/交接责任，workflow0不因自动查询升25%。delivery25%，[Q04](#research-q04)从只看指标到结构化训练库/日历内容有实际交付单元，超0；设备接收/运动验收未知不达50%。reach0%，[Q01](#research-q01)/[Q02](#research-q02)既有Garmin用户仍可通过官方应用或导出进入同类分析任务，没有明确此前受限群体被新增接入的证据；自然语言少写SDK代码是便利，不能因此升25%。[Q06](#research-q06)同设备/账号与模型供给，没有成本结构/服务组织改变，economics0，不因缓存节流或节时升25%。

recommendation.reason: 已有 Garmin 账号且接受指定数据进入所选模型的用户，可在专用 profile 只读一小段历史记录。它把稳定账号选择、认证和查询接到 DSH 或 MCP，减少手工搬运并明确部分写入结果边界。无法隔离训练写工具、核对数据来源或解释请求未知时，应停止试用并回官方应用。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)历史健身记录→自然语言核对/解释与官方应用基线明确，超25%偶发便利；缺真实反复痛点/效果不达75%，取50%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)tools66-153稳定账号/共享服务与[Q04](#research-q04)未知状态超25%入口；真实数据覆盖/训练效果和外部SDK未验不达75%，取50%。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)真实入口到provider、[Q03](#research-q03)凭据提交、[Q04](#research-q04)/[Q05](#research-q05)失败与副作用可追，支持限定查询试用超25%片段；无运行/完整SDK/宿主不达75%，取源码50%。

cost.rationale: [Q06](#research-q06)多peer/区域/凭据/浏览器/共享owner及隐私负担，写工具隔离需宿主，退出有跨适配器维护缺口，取25%；只读专用profile可退超0，未有完整退出/兼容验收不达50%。

publication.summaries.text: 在 DSH 与 MCP 中查询 Garmin 健身健康数据，并支持本地 FIT 导出及预览确认后的训练管理。

items.模型工具: 查询Garmin数据、本地知识、FIT导出及预览确认的训练管理
items.界面: Web登录/设置与教练面板接入
items.后台: 共享本地账号workspace与查询缓存

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 用途 | 条件与边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 数据查询 | 供Agent解释记录 | 稳定账号/provider覆盖 |
| 浏览器认证 | 本地会话 | 官方页/身份核对/私有目录 |
| 训练管理 | 创建/排期/删除 | 句柄约束非可信人批，未知先查 |
| FIT导出 | 本地文件 | 是本地写，限额非下载前总量 |
| 共享workspace | DSH/MCP同账号状态 | 单前端退出不等全部停止 |

publication.advice.text: 试用仅限已有账号的少量历史查询，专用profile隔离写/导出，稳定ID与官方应用核对。无法确认数据去向/写权限就停止，回官方应用/手工导出，见 [Q06](#research-q06)。

      "path": "README.md",
      "content": "# dsh-plugin-garmin-connect\n\n> A TypeScript-based Garmin Connect plugin and MCP server with **official Personal API and secure browser-based MFA**, built for DeepSeek Harness and designed to work with other AI agents.\n\n[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-garmin-connect.svg?logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-garmin-connect)\n[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-plugin-garmin-connect.svg?logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-garmin-connect)\n[![CI](https://github.com/Likenttt/garmin-connect-plugin-for-dsh/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/Likenttt/garmin-connect-plugin-for-dsh/actions/workflows/ci.yml)\n[![Test Report](https://img.shields.io/badge/test_report-view-blue.svg)](TEST_REPORT.md)\n[![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E20.19%20%7C%20%3E%3D22.13-brightgreen.svg)](https://nodejs.org)\n[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)\n\nEnglish | **[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)** | **[Test Report](TEST_REPORT.md)** | **[Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)**\n\n**Developed by Li Erniu (李二牛), connecting Garmin training to your AI assistant.**\n\nThis open-source DeepSeek Harness plugin and MCP connector support Garmin China and International accounts. Explore full activities and splits, sleep, heart rate and HRV with AI, then create, schedule or delete workouts or cancel calendar entries after your confirmation.\n\n**You control your account. Your password is not shared with AI.** With the recommended Garmin browser sign-in, passwords and verification codes are entered only on Garmin’s official page, not given to AI or the developer. Session credentials are stored locally with restricted file permissions. Authorized fitness and health queries return data to your chosen AI client for analysis.\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <picture>\n    <source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"docs/assets/coding-agents-dark.png\">\n    <source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"docs/assets/coding-agents-light.png\">\n    <img src=\"docs/assets/coding-agents-light.png\" width=\"720\" alt=\"DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, Qwen Work, ZCode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Windsurf\">\n  </picture>\n</p>\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <strong>Works with mainstream coding agents and AI workspaces</strong><br>\n  <a href=\"https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness\">DeepSeek Harness</a> ·\n  <a href=\"https://www.codebuddy.cn/work/\">WorkBuddy</a> ·\n  <a href=\"https://qwenwork.cn/\">Qwen Work</a> ·\n  <a href=\"https://zcode.z.ai/\">ZCode</a> ·\n  <a href=\"https://www.anthropic.com/claude-code\">Claude Code</a> ·\n  <a href=\"https://openai.com/codex/\">Codex</a> ·\n  <a href=\"https://www.cursor.com/\">Cursor</a> ·\n  <a href=\"https://windsurf.com/\">Windsurf</a><br>\n  <sub>Connect through MCP or a <code>SKILL.md</code> workflow, depending on the client.</sub>\n</p>\n\n> [!NOTE]\n> **MFA support in 0.1.6:** local dsh Web, the\n> `garmin-connect-auth serve` system-browser flow, and MCP URL elicitation can\n> bootstrap the same owner-only session for China and International accounts.\n> Real-account MFA completed in both regions on 2026-08-29, including a full\n> China-region browser-to-session-and-read chain and an International-region\n> system-browser DI exchange with owner-only session persistence. Browser policy\n> may still block an individual flow.\n> The older `login --browser` command is retained only as a diagnostic.\n\n---\n\n## More Apps\n\n| Icon | App | What it does |\n|---|---|---|\n| [<img src=\"https://wristtale.com/static/favicons/apple-touch-icon.png\" width=\"32\" height=\"32\" alt=\"WristTale\" />](https://wristtale.com) | [WristTale](https://wristtale.com) | Read TXT and Markdown on your [Garmin](https://wristtale.com/en/garmin-txt-reader), [Apple](https://wristtale.com/en/apple-watch-reader), and [Android](https://wristtale.com/en/android-watch-reader) watch |\n| [<img src=\"https://jiake.app/app-icon.png\" width=\"32\" height=\"32\" alt=\"JiaKe.app\" />](https://jiake.app) | [JiaKe.app](https://jiake.app) | Turn Garmin screenshots into polished assets |\n| [<img src=\"https://gamerasnap.com/static/images/appicon.png\" width=\"32\" height=\"32\" alt=\"GameraSnap\" />](https://gamerasnap.com) | [GameraSnap](https://gamerasnap.com) | Control your phone camera from your Garmin watch |\n| [<img src=\"https://wristalbum.wristtale.com/app-icon.svg\" width=\"32\" height=\"32\" alt=\"WristAlbum\" />](https://wristalbum.wristtale.com) | [WristAlbum](https://wristalbum.wristtale.com) | Keep a private photo album on your Garmin |\n| [<img src=\"https://wristpass.li2niu.com/static/favicons/apple-touch-icon.png\" width=\"32\" height=\"32\" alt=\"WristPass\" />](https://wristpass.li2niu.com) | [WristPass](https://wristpass.li2niu.com) | Keep cards and tickets ready on your wrist |\n| [<img src=\"https://2fa4g.li2niu.com/static/branding/app-icon.png\" width=\"32\" height=\"32\" alt=\"2FA4G\" />](https://2fa4g.li2niu.com) | [2FA4G](https://2fa4g.li2niu.com) | Keep offline 2FA codes on your Garmin |\n\n---\n\n## What It Does\n\nThis plugin connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) or any MCP-compatible AI agent to [Garmin Connect](https://connect.garmin.com/), exposing your wearable data as **AI-callable tools**. Once installed, the agent can automatically query your activities, sleep, steps, and heart rate to provide personalized fitness insights — all through natural language.\n\n### Registered Tools\n\nVersion **0.1.21 registers 30 tools in Harness** (including `list_garmin_accounts`) and **31 tools in shared-workspace MCP** (also including `open_garmin_workspace`). The selected account's provider determines which operations are available.\nLegacy single-account Connect MCP retains **29 tools**. Of those base tools, twenty-four provide queries or local advice without writing;\n`download_garmin_activity_fit` writes one local file on the MCP/dsh host. Creating, scheduling or deleting\na workout and cancelling a calendar entry change Garmin data after explicit confirmation.\nLegacy Personal MCP servers expose **15 compatible tools** for Garmin reads,\nlocal FIT downloads and local coaching knowledge. Harness and shared-workspace MCP\nkeep stable tool catalogs and route each call by the selected account’s capabilities.\nThe 13 recovery and training tools introduced in 0.1.14 depend on\nthe published maintained SDK through an exact npm alias; see\n[Maintained SDK dependency](#maintained-sdk-dependency).\n\n| Tool | Description | Example Args |\n|---|---|---|\n| `list_garmin_accounts` | Find stable account IDs by account note; available in Harness and shared-workspace MCP | `{\"limit\": 20}` |\n| `open_garmin_workspace` | Get a one-use link to the local management page; Missing answers are returned as focused questions; Garmin activity data\n  is not fetched and a schedule must not be generated yet.\n\n| Intake field | What the assistant must ask |\n|---|---|\n| `goal` | Target distance/event, future ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` date, and completion or ideal/minimum time goal |\n| `currentPerformance` + `performanceBasis` | A representative race/time trial from the past two years, result, non-future date, effort/conditions, or an explicit `no_recent_benchmark` |\n| `trainingBackground` | Running history and recent 4–8 week volume, frequency, long run, quality work, and interruptions |\n| `availability` | Available days/time, fixed rest and long-run days, terrain/facility limits, strength-training time, and whether double days are possible |\n| `healthConstraints` + `hasWarningSymptoms` | Current/past-year injury, pain, relevant disease/medication, sleep and recovery, plus an explicit warning-symptom boolean |\n| `trainingPreference` + preference details | `steady`, `hard_easy`, or `mixed`, plus `maxQualitySessionsPerWeek` (0–7) and `intensityGuidancePreference` (`pace`, `heart_rate`, `rpe`, or `mixed`) |\n\nIf `hasWarningSymptoms` is true—for example current chest discomfort,\nunusual breathlessness with mild activity, fainting/dizziness, or abnormal\npalpitations—the tool returns a safety stop without workout material or Garmin\nactivity access. Token export is intentionally not AI-callable; never\n> paste a token into an AI conversation.\n\n#### Two-step verification — browser-based MFA\n\n![Browser MFA login flow: passwords and verification codes go directly to Garmin](docs/assets/garmin-login-flow-no-password.svg)\n\nThis diagram covers browser MFA: passwords and verification codes go to Garmin's official page, and the plugin saves the session locally only after the user confirms the account.\n\nWhen dsh and its Web UI are running together on the same local machine, use the\nmatching **Log in** action in the plugin's **Garmin 账号配置** page after saving that\naccount's email. We first kept Garmin's official GAuth page inside a local iframe so the\nGarmin sign-in fields stayed on Garmin's origin, then worked through\ncross-origin messaging, missing vendor styles, browser CSP/Trusted Types,\nthird-party-frame policy, MFA redirects, and exact ticket/service binding.\nInspired by Zhitao's [DailySync](https://dailysync.cn) approach of completing\nGarmin SSO in a fresh browser tab, we added the system-browser loopback broker\nused by CLI and MCP clients. The tab returns only a short-lived, one-time service\nticket; the Host immediately exchanges it for the longer-lived DI session and\nrefresh credentials, verifies the Garmin profile, and writes an owner-only\nsession. In other words, the ticket itself is not a one-year credential—the\npotentially long-lived artifact is the exchanged session/refresh credential,\nwhose actual lifetime remains controlled by Garmin.\n\nGarmin sends its short-lived service ticket only to the isolated loopback bridge.\nThe bridge validates the expected region, message origin, iframe source, service,\nand ticket, then immediately hands it to the plugin Host for the region-bound DI\ntoken exchange. Garmin China may bind an MFA ticket to the exact current\n`http://127.0.0.1:<port>` bridge instead of the fixed Garmin embed URL; the\nplugin preserves that ticket/service pair unchanged and rejects every other\nloopback host, port, path, query, or region before contacting DI. It never\nrewrites or retries the one-time ticket with a fallback service. The Host probes the Garmin profile, shows a sanitized profile to\nthe user, and asks them to confirm that it corresponds to the configured email.\nOnly then does it atomically save an owner-only session bound to the configured\naccount and region. The outer dsh page receives public login progress; plugin\nsettings may display the account email after identity verification. The model\ncontext and AI-callable tool results never receive the ticket, DI token,\npassword, MFA code, or CAPTCHA response.\n\nAfter the Host verifies an account through password login, a profile-bound DI\nsession, or a newly confirmed Web login, that account's status in plugin settings\nshows it as signed in. out of AI conversations:\n\n```text\n┌──────────────────┐  ┌──────────────────┐  ┌──────────────────┐\n│ Harness settings │  │ MCP tool call    │  │ CLI serve        │\n│ account login    │  │ URL elicitation  │  │ system browser   │\n└────────┬─────────┘  └────────┬─────────┘  └────────┬─────────┘\n         └─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┘\n                               ▼\n          LocalAuthBroker + EmbeddedAuthController\n                               │\n                               ▼\n          random one-shot 127.0.0.1 bridge\n          flowId + CSRF + strict CSP + 10-minute TTL\n                               │ embeds the exact regional page\n                               ▼\n          official Garmin GAuth iframe (cn / global)\n          Garmin sign-in inputs stay here\n                               │\n                               │ one-time ticket + original exact service\n                               ▼\n          Host validates origin / iframe / CSRF / ticket / service\n                               │\n                               ▼\n          regional DI exchange → profile probe → user confirmation\n                               │\n                               ▼\n          atomically persist an owner-only DI v2 session\n          bound to account, region, and profile; never shared by processes\n                               │\n                               ▼\n          GarminClient hot-load / safe refresh\n                               │\n                               ▼\n          user explicitly retries the original tool call\n```\n\nThe non-negotiable boundaries are:\n\n- During authentication, the outer dsh page receives a one-time local URL and\n  coarse progress; its separate local settings form handles the account email.\n  MCP clients and the model receive only a URL, completion notification, or\n  coarse non-sensitive status. Tickets, DI tokens, session contents, and session\n  paths never enter model context or AI tool arguments/results.\n- The bridge accepts only the expected Garmin SSO origin, iframe window, CSRF,\n  and an exactly matched `ticket/service` pair. It never rewrites the service,\n  follows a redirect, or retries a one-time ticket against a fallback.\n- Before saving a session, the Host probes the Garmin profile and asks the user\n  to confirm the account. It then writes the session atomically with private\n  permissions. A running client hot-loads only a changed, account-matching,\n  validated session.\n- Authentication never replays the original tool automatically, preventing\n  duplicate FIT downloads or workout writes. Failure, cancellation, or timeout\n  ends the flow; another attempt creates a new flow.\n- Refresh may replay a safe GET at most once. It first verifies the same profile\n  and persists rotated tokens; writes are never replayed after refresh.\n\n> [!NOTE]\n> This is the target architecture and the boundary followed by the current\n> release-supported implementation. A real China-region MFA → exact ticket/service\n> → DI exchange → profile confirmation → private session write → fresh-client\n> read chain has passed locally. A real International-region MFA → DI exchange\n> → profile confirmation → private session write also passed.       "content": "import { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport { Config, type PluginConfig, resolveAccountConfigs, resolveConfig } from './config'\nimport { createGarminClient } from './client-factory'\nimport { registerEmbeddedAuthRpcAccounts } from './embedded-auth-rpc'\nimport { registerTools } from './tools'\nimport { createHash } from 'node:crypto'\nimport { registerCoachPanel } from './coach-panel'\nimport { createAccountRegistry } from './account-registry'\nimport { registerHarnessWorkspace } from './workspace-harness'\n\nexport const name = 'garmin-connect'\nexport { Config, resolveConfig }\nexport const inject = ['tools']\n\ndeclare module '@deepseek-ai/cordis' {\n  interface Events {\n    'loader/volatile-update'(paths: readonly (readonly string[])[]): void\n  }\n}\n\nexport function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config | PluginConfig) {\n  const legacySeeds = resolveAccountConfigs(config)\n  const baseConfig = resolveConfig(config)\n\n  // Loader commits volatile fields without remounting the plugin. Rebuild the\n  // client, tools, and auth controller together from the newly committed refs.\n  let restartQueued = false\n  ctx.on('loader/volatile-update', paths => {\n    if (\n      restartQueued\n      || !paths.some(path => path.length === 1 && [\n        'username', 'region',\n        'cnUsername', 'cnAlias', 'cnConfigured',\n        'globalUsername', 'globalAlias', 'globalConfigured',\n        'accounts', 'accountsConfigured',\n        'authVerbose',\n        'account1Username', 'account2Username', 'account3Username',\n        'account4Username', 'account5Username',\n        'account1UsernameId', 'account2UsernameId', 'account3UsernameId',\n        'account4UsernameId', 'account5UsernameId',\n        'provider', 'accountAlias', 'personalApiKey', 'personalApiKeyFile',\n        'account1PersonalApiKey', 'account2PersonalApiKey', 'account3PersonalApiKey',\n        'account4PersonalApiKey', 'account5PersonalApiKey',\n        'account1PersonalApiKeyId', 'account2PersonalApiKeyId', 'account3PersonalApiKeyId',\n        'account4PersonalApiKeyId', 'account5PersonalApiKeyId',\n      ].includes(path[0]))\n    ) return\n    restartQueued = true\n    queueMicrotask(() => {\n      restartQueued = false\n      if (ctx.fiber.uid === null) return\n      void ctx.fiber.restart().catch(() => {\n        ctx.logger.error('[garmin] Could not apply updated account settings')\n      })\n    })\n  })\n\n  // Scope local coaching records to the Host configuration, independently of\n  // account additions/removals or the transient plugin fiber instance.\n  ctx.inject(['loader'], scopeCtx => {\n    const loader = (scopeCtx as unknown as {\n      loader?: { config?: { baseUrl?: string | URL } }\n    }).loader\n    // Desktop may set baseUrl on the loading context before constructing the\n    // Loader, leaving its optional config.baseUrl unset.\n    const baseUrl = loader?.config?.baseUrl\n      ?? (scopeCtx as unknown as { baseUrl?: string | URL }).baseUrl\n    const scopeId = baseUrl\n      ? createHash('sha256').update(String(baseUrl)).digest('hex')\n      : undefined\n    if (scopeId) {\n      registerHarnessWorkspace(scopeCtx, { scopeId, legacySeeds, baseConfig })\n      return\n    }\n    const accounts = createAccountRegistry({\n      legacySeeds, baseConfig, scopeId,\n      createClient: accountConfig => createGarminClient(scopeCtx, accountConfig, { allowUnconfigured: true }),\n    })\n    // Every consumer waits for catalog readiness and selects a current account.\n    // Neither registration nor a local member list constructs/logs in SDK clients.\n    registerTools(scopeCtx, accounts)\n    registerEmbeddedAuthRpcAccounts(scopeCtx, accounts)\n    registerCoachPanel(scopeCtx, accounts, { scopeId })\n    scopeCtx.effect(() => () => accounts.close(), 'garmin-connect: account registry')\n  })\n}\n"

      "content": "/**\n * An in-memory cache with TTL, LRU eviction, and single-flight refreshes.\n *\n * Purpose: Garmin's unofficial API is aggressive with rate-limiting and can be slow.\n * This cache prevents the AI agent from hammering the API when it retries,\n * Expired entries block on one shared refresh so callers never receive unmarked stale data.\n */\ninterface CacheEntry {\n  value: unknown\n  expiresAt: number\n}\n\nexport class MemoryCache {\n  private store = new Map<string, CacheEntry>()\n  private pending = new Map<string, Promise<unknown>>()\n  private ttlMs: number\n  private maxSize: number\n\n  constructor(ttlSeconds: number, maxSize = 100) {\n    this.ttlMs = ttlSeconds * 1000\n    this.maxSize = maxSize\n  }\n\n  /** Return a cached value, or call `factory`, cache & return the result. */\n  async getOrSet<T>(key: string, factory: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {\n    if (this.ttlMs <= 0 || this.maxSize <= 0) {\n      // Cache disabled\n      return factory()\n    }\n\n    const entry = this.store.get(key)\n    const isExpired = !entry || Date.now() >= entry.expiresAt\n\n    if (entry && !isExpired) {\n      // 1. Fresh data, just return it\n      this.refreshLRU(key, entry)\n      return entry.value as T\n    }\n\n    // 2. Data is stale or absent. We need to fetch.\n    // Ensure only one background fetch per key.\n    if (!this.pending.has(key)) {\n      let fetchPromise: Promise<T>\n      fetchPromise = factory()\n        .then((value) => {\n          // Invalidating a key detaches its old request. Only the currently\n          // registered request may populate the cache.\n          if (this.pending.get(key) === fetchPromise) this.set(key, value)\n          return value\n        })\n        .finally(() => {\n          if (this.pending.get(key) === fetchPromise) this.pending.delete(key)\n        })\n      this.pending.set(key, fetchPromise)\n    }\n\n    // Expired and missing entries both wait for the shared refresh.\n    return this.pending.get(key) as Promise<T>\n  }\n\n  private set(key: string, value: unknown): void {\n    // A refreshed existing key is the most-recently used entry too.\n    this.store.delete(key)\n    if (this.store.size >= this.maxSize) {\n      // Evict oldest (Map iterates in insertion order)\n      const oldestKey = this.store.keys().next().value\n      if (oldestKey !== undefined) {\n        this.store.delete(oldestKey)\n      }\n    }\n    const now = Date.now()\n    this.store.set(key, {\n      value,\n      expiresAt: now + this.ttlMs,\n    })\n  }\n\n  private refreshLRU(key: string, entry: CacheEntry): void {\n    // Delete and re-insert to move to end of iteration order (most recently used)\n    this.store.delete(key)\n    this.store.set(key, entry)\n  }\n\n  /** Manually invalidate a single key. */\n  invalidate(key: string): void {\n    this.store.delete(key)\n    this.pending.delete(key)\n  }\n\n  /** Invalidate all keys that start with the given prefix. */\n  invalidatePrefix(prefix: string): void {\n    for (const key of [...this.store.keys()]) {\n      if (key.startsWith(prefix)) this.store.delete(key)\n    }\n    for (const key of [...this.pending.keys()]) {\n      if (key.startsWith(prefix)) this.pending.delete(key)\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** Drop everything. */\n  clear(): void {\n    this.store.clear()\n    this.pending.clear()\n  }\n}\n"

throw error })\n    return owner\n  }\n  const descriptor = { scopeId: options.scopeId, dataDirectory: defaultWorkspaceDirectory() }\n  // Publish discovery metadata on plugin load, so standalone MCP finds the exact\n  // Host namespace even before its first data request. This does not start a process.\n  const registered = registerWorkspace(descriptor)\n  void registered.catch(() => ctx.logger.error('[garmin] Could not register the local workspace'))\n  async function initialize(): Promise<Adapter> {\n    await registered\n    const lease = await acquireWorkspaceLease(descriptor)\n    if (!lease) {\n      const remote = await connectWorkspace(descriptor)\n      const applied = await remote.configure({\n        cacheTtl: options.baseConfig.cacheTtl, requestTimeoutMs: options.baseConfig.requestTimeoutMs ?? 15_000,\n        logLevel: options.baseConfig.logLevel, authVerbose: options.baseConfig.authVerbose === true,\n        activityDetail: options.baseConfig.activityDetail, fitDownloadDir: options.baseConfig.fitDownloadDir,\n      }) as { success?: boolean }\n      if (applied?.success !== true) { await remote.close(); throw new Error('Could not synchronize Garmin workspace settings') }\n      cleanup = () => remote.close()\n      if (disposed) { await cleanup(); throw new Error('Garmin workspace is closed') }\n      return remote\n    }\n    const accounts = createAccountRegistry({ ...options, dataDirectory: descriptor.dataDirectory,\n      createClient: config => createGarminClient(ctx, config, { allowUnconfigured: true }),\n    })\n    let service: WorkspaceService | undefined\n    let server: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof startWorkspaceServer>> | undefined\n    try {\n      service = createWorkspaceService(accounts, { ...descriptor, logger: ctx.logger })\n      await accounts.ready()\n      const accessToken = randomBytes(24).toString('hex')\n      server = await startWorkspaceServer({ service, accessToken, instanceId: lease.instanceId })\n      await lease.publish({ origin: server.origin, accessToken })\n      cleanup = async () => {\n        try { await server!.close() }\n        finally {\n          try { await service!.close() }\n          finally { accounts.close(); await lease.close() }\n      }\n      throw error\n    }\n  }\n  // Capture the existing definitions and renderers; only execution is forwarded.\n  const empty: AccountSource = { ready: async () => undefined, list: () => [], subscribe: () => () => undefined }\n  const toolContext = {\n    logger: ctx.logger,\n    effect: (callback: () => () => void, label?: string) => ctx.effect(callback, label),\n    tools: { register: (definition: WorkspaceToolDefinition) => (ctx as any).tools.register({\n      ...definition, execute: async (args: unknown) => {\n        try { return await (await getOwner()).invokeTool(definition.name, args) }\n        catch { return { error: true, message: 'The local Garmin workspace is unavailable. '', 'http://dsh.internal').pathname) } catch { /* unrelated */ }\n        if (!protectedPath || isCoachLoopback(request.socket.remoteAddress)) { await next(); return }\n        response.writeHead(403, { 'cache-control': 'no-store' }); dataDirectory: string; logger: Context['logger'] },\n): WorkspaceService {\n  const disposers: Array<() => unknown> = []\n  const tools: WorkspaceToolDefinition[] = []\n  let authHandler: ((endpoint: string, payload: unknown, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<any>) | undefined\n  const context: any = {\n    logger: options.logger,\n    tools: { register: (tool: WorkspaceToolDefinition) => tools.push(tool) },\n    connection: { rpc: { handle: (_channel: string, handler: typeof authHandler) => {\n      authHandler = handler\n      return () => { authHandler = undefined }\n    } } },\n    effect(callback: () => () => unknown) { disposers.push(callback()) },\n    inject(_dependencies: string[], callback: (ctx: Context) => void) { callback(context) },\n  }\n  registerTools(context, accounts)\n  registerEmbeddedAuthRpcAccounts(context, accounts)\n  const panel = new CoachPanelService(accounts, options)\n  const byName = new Map(tools.map(tool => [tool.name, tool]))\n  let closed = false\n  return {\n    tools,\n    async configure(config) {\n      if (closed || !runtimeConfig(config)) return { success: false, code: 'invalid' }\n      await accounts.ready()\n      await (accounts as Partial<MutableAccountRegistry>).reconfigure?.(config)\n      return { success: true }\n    },\n    call: (endpoint, payload, signal) => panel.handle(endpoint, payload, signal),\n    async auth(endpoint, payload, signal) {\n      if (closed || !authHandler) return { success: false, code: 'unavailable' }\n      const result = await authHandler(endpoint, payload, signal ?? new AbortController().signal)\n      return result?.ok === true ? result.value : { success: false, code: 'unavailable' }\n    },\n    async invokeTool(name, args) {\n      if (closed) return { error: true, message: 'Garmin workspace is unavailable.
